rationale: The child question now has its own receipt (CheckRun 4dd05e7a3c6b4894ad3c7d66fe58a201), so its answer no longer has to be read out of the main account: all twelve comparisons resolved as before, with the under-lease controls holding, the peer-form message accepted, the same pre-vote granted after it, the leader's next heartbeat restoring the context and the pre-vote ignored again, and the quorum stream carrying the candidate to leadership at term 3 while the incumbent still reported leadership.

interpretations.rationale: Both halves of the question are answered by this receipt. Duration: after the accepted message cleared the follower's context, the leader's next real heartbeat, produced by one further logical tick with HeartbeatTick=1, restored it (index 7) and the identical pre-vote was ignored again with no response (index 8), so the suppression stays off only until the next genuine leader message rather than for a fixed extra interval. Quorum scale: one forged delivery to the other voter was enough (index 13, accepted), the same pre-vote was granted (index 14), the follower then granted the real vote (index 15), and the candidate held leadership at term 3 while the incumbent still reported leadership at term 2 (index 17, with the incumbent state outside the cited subset). Controls in the same receipt hold: the local-type message is still rejected with ErrStepLocalMsg (index 3), the under-lease pre-vote is not granted in either stream (indices 4 and 10), and the local API produces the same lead transition the network path should not reach (index 2). The mechanism is the one in the main account: the type is missing from isLocalMsg although only the local ForgetLeader APIs produce it, and the peer-form message carries no term so Step treats it as local and skips term checks.
counterevidence: The competing explanation that this follower grants pre-votes and votes regardless of its leader is excluded by the under-lease controls in the same receipt (indices 4 and 10).
The change is per-message and reversible: the next genuine leader heartbeat restored the context and the same pre-vote was ignored again (indices 7 and 8).
limitations: Single process with hand-delivered messages and one tick configuration; the window bound is in ticks, not wall-clock time.
The quorum scenario uses one voter plus the candidate, so the quorum size itself was not varied.
ReadOnlyLeaseBased configurations still refuse the message, so this does not bear on lease-based reads.
